headline: Nigerian President Requests Approval for $21.7 Billion Foreign Borrowing Plan
summary: President Bola Tinubu submitted a fresh request to Nigeria's National Assembly seeking authorization for $21.67 billion in external loans to finance economic and infrastructure development.
why: Nigeria balances fiscal revenue shortfalls and high debt-servicing burdens against the need to fund critical public infrastructure and support economic growth.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Substantial external borrowing provides capital funding but elevates sovereign debt metrics and fiscal risks.
